question: For order 423, identify the product IDs, aisles, and positions from which to pick the exact quantities needed for each order line, ensuring that the total picked quantity for each product matches the cumulative quantities ordered without exceeding the available inventory in warehouse 1. Calculate the quantities to be picked from each location by prioritizing inventory with earlier purchased dates and smaller quantities, and ensure that picking respects the sequence and cumulative quantities of the order lines for products with multiple entries.
sql:
WITH order_lines AS (
    SELECT ol.id, ol.order_id, ol.product_id, ol.qty as qty_ordered,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ol.order_id, ol.product_id ORDER BY ol.id) as ol_rn
    FROM orderlines ol
    WHERE ol.order_id = 423
),
order_cumulative AS (
    SELECT *,
        SUM(qty_ordered) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY ol_rn) as cum_ordered_up_to,
        COALESCE(SUM(qty_ordered) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY ol_rn ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) as cum_ordered_before
    FROM order_lines
),
inventory_sorted AS (
    SELECT 
        inv.id as inv_id, inv.product_id, inv.location_id, l.aisle, l.position, inv.qty as available_qty,
        p.purchased,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inv.product_id ORDER BY p.purchased, inv.qty) as inv_rn
    FROM inventory inv
    JOIN locations l ON inv.location_id = l.id
    JOIN purchases p ON inv.purchase_id = p.id
    WHERE l.warehouse = 1
),
inventory_cumulative AS (
    SELECT *,
        SUM(available_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY inv_rn) as cum_available_up_to,
        COALESCE(SUM(available_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY inv_rn ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) as cum_available_before
    FROM inventory_sorted
),
matched AS (
    SELECT 
        oc.product_id,
        oc.ol_rn,
        oc.qty_ordered as line_qty,
        oc.cum_ordered_before,
        oc.cum_ordered_up_to,
        ic.inv_id, ic.location_id, ic.aisle, ic.position, ic.available_qty,
        ic.inv_rn,
        ic.cum_available_up_to,
        ic.cum_available_before
    FROM order_cumulative oc
    JOIN inventory_cumulative ic ON oc.product_id = ic.product_id
),
pick_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        m.product_id,
        m.ol_rn,
        m.line_qty,
        m.location_id,
        m.aisle,
        m.position,
        m.available_qty,
        m.inv_rn,
        GREATEST(0, 
            LEAST(m.cum_ordered_up_to, m.cum_available_up_to) - 
            GREATEST(m.cum_ordered_before, m.cum_available_before)
        ) as raw_pick
    FROM matched m
)
SELECT 
    product_id,
    aisle,
    position,
    raw_pick as qty_to_pick
FROM pick_calc
WHERE raw_pick > 0
ORDER BY product_id, inv_rn
